Controlling for inflation and PPP, Japan's GDP per capita rose roughly 8- to 10-fold from 1950 to 2016, from about $3,000–4,000 to $38,000–40,000 in 2011 international dollars. Since the provided options are 5-fold or 20-fold, my estimate sits between them but closer to neither extreme, so I would lean toward the 5-fold option only if the 1950 baseline is taken higher. Given the ambiguity, I'll state my best estimate as roughly 8- to 10-fold rather than force either option.
CONFIDENCE: 70
